card.name: Qualifier words before medical terms
card.fires_on: Single words that begin a two-part medical phrase and follow a clinical qualifier, such as 'decision' after 'clinical', 'silent' before 'ischemia', or 'narrow' before '-angle glaucoma'. It appears in drug label warnings and contraindications.

modes.label: Narrow-angle glaucoma
modes.description: The word 'narrow' after 'acute' or 'uncontrolled', before '-angle glaucoma'.
